testCases.title: Verify Category Page Display and Title
steps: Check that the category name is displayed as the page title.
Verify the relevant products associated with the category are displayed.
expectedResults: The category name is shown as the page title.
The relevant products for the selected category are visible on the page.

testCases.title: Verify Availability of Filters on Category Page
steps: Check for the presence of all filters available in the product overview.
expectedResults: All filters that are available in the product overview are present on the category page.
